title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
summary: Generative simulation for surgical robotics still lacks real-time interaction. Physical-robot experiments, often involving animal or cadaver labs, are time-consuming, costly, and difficult to reproduce, while classical simulators struggle to capture photorealistic appearance and deformable-tissue dynamics. We address this gap with Cosmos-H-Dreams, an integrated real-time surgical world-model system combining an action-conditioned generative model, a teacher-to-student distillation recipe, and a deployment stack built on the NVIDIA FlashDreams streaming-inference library. Starting from Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, a multi-embodiment action-conditioned surgical video world model fine-tuned on the large-scale Open-H-Embodiment corpus, we post-train this checkpoint on embodiment- and procedure-specific data. By distilling the resulting bidirectional teacher into a causal, few-step student with Self Forcing, we turn a passive video generator into a controllable surgical simulator that streams at $\sim$160 inference FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation GPU. Crucially, Cosmos-H-Dreams is controller-agnostic: any interface that emits a stream of robot kinematics can drive it. We demonstrate live control through a browser keyboard over WebRTC, a Meta Quest headset over WebXR, a commercial surgical robot console such as CMR Surgical's Versius, and learned policies operating in closed loop. To our knowledge, this is the first interactive surgical world model supporting live human and policy control. Human operators and policies alike can act inside the synthesized world and observe the consequences in real time. We release Cosmos-H-Dreams as an open surgical simulation system, providing a common foundation for surgical education, scalable synthetic data generation, and future intraoperative decision support.
tldr: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams presents a real-time generative physics simulation system for surgical robotics, using an action-conditioned world model with teacher-to-student distillation and streaming inference to achieve ~160 FPS on a single GPU, enabling live human and policy control for training, data generation, and decision support.
tldr_zh: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams 提出了一种用于手术机器人的实时生成式物理仿真系统，通过动作条件世界模型与教师-学生蒸馏及流式推理，在单GPU上实现约160 FPS，支持人类和政策实时控制，用于训练、数据生成和决策支持。
summary_zh: 手术机器人领域的生成式仿真仍缺乏实时交互能力。涉及动物或尸体实验室的物理机器人实验耗时、昂贵且难以复现，而经典仿真器难以捕捉逼真外观与可变形组织动力学。我们通过Cosmos-H-Dreams系统弥补了这一空白，该系统是一个集成的实时手术世界模型，包含动作条件生成模型、师生蒸馏方案以及基于NVIDIA FlashDreams流式推理库的部署栈。我们从Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator出发——一个在大规模Open-H-Embodiment语料库上微调的多实体动作条件手术视频世界模型——在该检查点上针对特定实体和手术流程数据进行后训练。通过将双向教师模型利用自强制（Self Forcing）方法蒸馏为因果、少步学生模型，我们将被动视频生成器转化为可控手术模拟器，该模拟器在单个NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell工作站GPU上以约160推理FPS的速度进行流式处理。关键在于，Cosmos-H-Dreams与控制器无关：任何输出机器人运动学流的接口均可驱动它。我们展示了通过WebRTC的浏览器键盘、通过WebXR的Meta Quest头显、商业手术机器人控制台（如CMR Surgical的Versius）以及闭环运行的已学习策略实现实时控制。据我们所知，这是首个支持人类与策略实时控制的交互式手术世界模型。人类操作员和策略均可在合成世界中行动并实时观察后果。我们将Cosmos-H-Dreams作为开源手术仿真系统发布，为手术教育、可扩展合成数据生成以及未来术中决策支持提供共同基础。

title: Coverage Planning for Robotic Tooth Preparation in Densely Constrained Environments
summary: Tooth preparation refers to the controlled removal of tooth structure to create an optimal substrate for fixed restorations and is a core procedure in restorative dentistry. Automating this task is particularly challenging for robots because the dental bur must operate within a densely constrained intraoral workspace, where even sub-millimeter deviations can compromise outcomes or damage adjacent structures. This paper presents a novel robotic system for autonomous full-crown tooth preparation. The proposed framework includes: 1) an anatomy-aware toolpath planning algorithm that conforms precisely to a technician-designed preparation model while protecting adjacent teeth, and 2) a clearance-oriented end-effector yaw assignment strategy that allows intraoral access while reducing the risk of soft-tissue interference. Together, these features enable the robot to accurately mill the irregular tooth surface with an average geometric deviation of 0.117 mm (RMSE), achieving both restoration quality and clinical safety. A series of simulations and phantom-head experiments validate the system's feasibility and effectiveness.
tldr: This paper presents a robotic system for autonomous full-crown tooth preparation, featuring anatomy-aware toolpath planning and a clearance-oriented yaw assignment strategy, achieving 0.117 mm RMSE deviation in simulations and phantom experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自主全冠牙体预备的机器人系统，包含解剖感知的刀具路径规划和面向间隙的末端偏航分配策略，在仿真和体模实验中实现了0.117毫米的均方根误差偏差。
summary_zh: 牙体预备是指通过可控方式去除牙体组织，为固定修复体建立最优基面，是修复牙科的核心操作。由于牙科车针必须在空间高度受限的口内工作，即使亚毫米级偏差也可能影响治疗效果或损伤邻近组织，因此实现这一过程的自动化对机器人而言极具挑战。本文提出了一种用于全冠牙体自动预备的新型机器人系统。该系统框架包括：1）一种符合解剖结构的刀具路径规划算法，该算法在保护邻牙的同时精准贴合技师设计的预备体模型；2）一种面向间隙的末端执行器偏航分配策略，可在进入口内工作空间的同时降低软组织干涉风险。这两项功能共同使机器人能够精确磨削不规则牙面，几何偏差平均值（均方根误差）为0.117毫米，兼顾修复质量与临床安全性。一系列仿真与仿真头模实验验证了该系统的可行性与有效性。

title: EviDx: Evidence-Aware Active Diagnosis with Scaffolded LLM Agents
summary: Clinical diagnosis is an active evidence-seeking process in which clinicians acquire evidence, update competing hypotheses, and decide when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. Yet many medical diagnosis systems built around large language models (LLMs) still formulate diagnosis as static case-to-answer prediction, with limited support for evidence acquisition. Agentic LLMs offer a dynamic alternative through tool use and intermediate diagnostic trajectories, but existing systems often under-specify how patient evidence should be exposed, scaffolded, and controlled at runtime. We introduce EviDx, an evidence-aware active diagnosis framework that pairs patient-specific diagnostic environments with a clinical diagnostic scaffold and an observer-guided runtime harness. In EviDx, $\mathcal{E}$-Synthesis constructs interactive environments from raw clinical cases; the scaffold organizes role-specialized agents, evidence tools, and evolving evidence states; and the harness regulates diagnostic termination by tracking uncertainty and evidence coverage. A 3-level evaluation pyramid assesses execution robustness, reasoning dynamics, and diagnostic outcomes. Experiments show that EviDx improves diagnostic performance and process stability while revealing model-dependent capability boundaries.
tldr: EviDx is a framework that uses scaffolded LLM agents for evidence-aware active clinical diagnosis, building interactive patient environments, organizing specialized agents, and using an observer-guided harness to control diagnostic termination, demonstrating improved performance and stability over static diagnosis systems.
tldr_zh: EviDx 是一个使用结构化的 LLM 智能体进行证据感知主动临床诊断的框架，构建交互式患者环境、组织专业智能体，并使用观察者引导的控制机制来管理诊断终止，实验表明其相比静态诊断系统在性能和稳定性上有所提升。
summary_zh: 临床诊断是一个主动寻求证据的过程，在此过程中，临床医生获取证据、更新相互竞争的假设，并判断现有证据何时足以做出诊断。然而，许多基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的医疗诊断系统仍将诊断视为静态的病例到答案预测，对证据获取的支持有限。智能体化LLM通过工具使用和中间诊断轨迹提供了一种动态替代方案，但现有系统往往未能充分说明患者证据在运行时应如何暴露、支撑和控制。我们提出EviDx，一个证据感知的主动诊断框架，它将患者特定的诊断环境与临床诊断支架以及观察者引导的运行时管理机制相结合。在EviDx中，$\mathcal{E}$-Synthesis从原始临床病例构建交互环境；支架组织角色专业化智能体、证据工具和不断演化的证据状态；管理机制通过跟踪不确定性和证据覆盖来调控诊断终止。一个三级评估金字塔用于评估执行鲁棒性、推理动态和诊断结果。实验表明，EviDx提升了诊断性能和过程稳定性，同时揭示了模型依赖的能力边界。

title: StrokeGuard: A Multi-Agent Guided System for Prehospital Stroke Assessment
summary: Prehospital stroke assessment aims to accurately identify stroke symptoms and make rapid decisions through standardized procedures within an extremely narrow time window, thereby saving valuable time for subsequent treatment. In clinical practice, FAST-based scales are widely used for prehospital stroke assessment by issuing instructions that guide subjects to perform specific actions to screen facial, arm, and speech functions. However, in home and community settings, non-clinical users often encounter challenges such as inaccurate descriptions, incomplete symptom observation, and difficult operational procedures, which may lead to inaccurate or biased assessment results. To address these challenges, this paper presents StrokeGuard: a multi-agent guided system designed for prehospital stroke assessment that makes mobile FAST screening more standardized and executable. Specifically, to overcome the limitations of traditional single-agent systems in terms of procedural fault tolerance and user guidance capability, StrokeGuard adopts a dual-channel agent mechanism that separates formal assessment (i.e., facial palsy, arm weakness, speech impairment) from procedural support (e.g., step prompts, error correction, and real-time feedback). It guides the assessment process through multi-agent collaboration, dual-channel interaction, state-machine control, and stage-local fallback recovery mechanisms. Stage-specific scoring is delegated to constrained pretrained video assessment modules, while evidence source records are integrated with structured report generation. The user evaluation uses MATES-9, an exploratory scale for measuring user experience in multistep AI-guided tasks. In a simulated prehospital scenario, StrokeGuard improves the MATES-9 total score over a paper FAST-style form by 10.83 points, corresponding to a 23.8% relative increase.
tldr: StrokeGuard is a multi-agent system that improves prehospital stroke assessment using a dual-channel mechanism separating formal assessment from procedural support, achieving a 23.8% relative increase in user experience over paper-based FAST forms.
tldr_zh: StrokeGuard 是一个多智能体系统，通过将正式评估与程序支持分离的双通道机制改善院前卒中评估，在用户体验上比纸质FAST表格相对提升了23.8%。
summary_zh:
摘要：
院前卒中评估旨在极为狭窄的时间窗内，通过标准化流程准确识别卒中症状并快速决策，从而为后续治疗争取宝贵时间。临床实践中，基于FAST的评估量表通过发出指令引导受试者完成特定动作，以筛查面部、手臂及言语功能，被广泛应用于院前卒中评估。然而，在家庭和社区场景中，非临床用户常面临描述不准确、症状观察不完整、操作流程困难等挑战，可能导致评估结果不精确或存在偏差。为解决这些问题，本文提出StrokeGuard：一种专为院前卒中评估设计的多智能体引导系统，使移动端FAST筛查更加标准化且可执行。具体而言，为克服传统单智能体系统在流程容错性和用户引导能力方面的局限，StrokeGuard采用双通道智能体机制，将正式评估（即面部麻痹、手臂无力、言语障碍）与流程支持（如步骤提示、纠错和实时反馈）相分离。它通过多智能体协作、双通道交互、状态机控制以及阶段局部回退恢复机制引导评估过程。针对不同阶段的评分被委托给受约束的预训练视频评估模块，同时将证据源记录与结构化报告生成相结合。用户评估采用MATES-9——一种用于测量多步骤AI引导任务中用户体验的探索性量表。在模拟院前场景中，相比纸质FAST样式表格，StrokeGuard将MATES-9总分提升了10.83分，相对提高了23.8%。

title: RefineRank: Joint Box Refinement and Ranking for Surgical Spatio-Temporal Grounding
summary: Surgical spatio-temporal grounding (STG) requires locating, at each video time specified by a procedural question, the object that the question asks about. Existing approaches face a trade-off: vision language models understand the question context but produce imprecise coordinates, whereas open-set detectors provide localized candidate boxes whose confidence does not reflect which box answers the question. We introduce RefineRank, which closes this gap at the candidate-box level. A compact trainable module, RefineNet, combines the language and regional features of a frozen medical vision language model with the proposals of a frozen open-set detector: it predicts a bounded coordinate correction and a quality score for every candidate box, and a fixed decoding rule returns the original or refined box with the highest score. On the MedVidBench Official Rankings (Verified), RefineRank records 0.421 STG mIoU, the highest displayed STG score, while its global multi-metric rank is 11. In a controlled evaluation on separate training and evaluation videos, coordinate correction raises the candidate oracle upper bound from 0.6772 to 0.7302, and ranking the joint pool of original and refined candidates by their RefineNet scores improves STG mIoU from 0.2719 to 0.4534, whereas separately trained selectors over the same pool reach at most 0.4186. These results show that a small box-level module can reconcile question understanding with precise localization without retraining either backbone. Code is available at [https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank](https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank).
tldr: This paper presents RefineRank, a method that jointly refines and ranks candidate object boxes from an open-set detector using a frozen medical vision-language model, achieving state-of-the-art surgical spatio-temporal grounding on MedVidBench.
tldr_zh: 本文提出RefineRank方法，联合优化并排序来自开放集检测器的候选框，利用冻结的医学视觉语言模型，在MedVidBench上实现最先进的手术时空定位。
summary_zh: 手术时空定位（STG）需要在由程序性问题指定的每个视频时间点，定位该问题所询问的目标。现有方法面临一种权衡：视觉语言模型能够理解问题上下文但生成的坐标不精确，而开放集检测器提供定位后的候选框，但其置信度无法反映哪个框回答了问题。我们提出RefineRank，它在候选框层面弥合了这一差距。一个紧凑的可训练模块RefineNet，将冻结的医学视觉语言模型的语言和区域特征与冻结的开放集检测器的提议相结合：它为每个候选框预测一个有界坐标修正和一个质量分数，并通过固定解码规则返回得分最高的原始或精炼框。在MedVidBench官方排名（已验证）中，RefineRank取得了0.421的STG mIoU，是显示的最高STG分数，而其全局多指标排名为第11位。在分离训练和评估视频的受控评估中，坐标修正将候选框的理想上界从0.6772提升至0.7302，而通过RefineNet分数对原始和精炼候选框的联合池进行排序，使STG mIoU从0.2719提升至0.4534，相比之下，在同一候选池上单独训练的选取器最多达到0.4186。这些结果表明，一个轻量级的候选框级模块可以在无需重新训练任何主干网络的情况下，协调问题理解与精确定位。代码已开源在 [https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank](https://github.com/linzhe001/RefineRank)。

title: LUCAID: Agentic Multimodal AI for Lung Cancer Precision Pathology
summary: Lung cancer tissue diagnostics is complex, as therapy decisions in precision oncology rely on the integration of histomorphological, immunohistochemical, and molecular features. Yet pathological assessment remains largely visual and semi-quantitative and shows interobserver variability, while existing artificial intelligence (AI) tools cover only selected tasks, rarely reach generalizable expert-level performance, and lack prospective clinical validation. To address these challenges, we developed and clinically validated LUCAID, an agentic AI system for precision lung cancer pathology. An integrative agent couples diagnostic reasoning with nine modules that cover the full routine workflow, from quality control, tumor detection and segmentation, histological subtyping, tumor microenvironment profiling, tumor cellularity quantification, and predictive biomarker scoring (PD-L1, MET, TROP-2) to automated structured report generation. LUCAID enables users to interactively query the module outputs and generate reports that contextualize the results. Against large-scale expert ground-truth annotations, the analysis modules achieved F1 scores of 0.82-0.95. In prospective clinical validation, LUCAID reached 93.0% concordance with an expert-panel adjudicated reference standard across clinically actionable decisions, compared with 68.3-81.1% for five experienced thoracic pathologists.
tldr: LUCAID is an agentic multimodal AI system for lung cancer precision pathology that integrates nine diagnostic modules from quality control to report generation, achieving high concordance in prospective clinical validation with expert pathologists.
tldr_zh: LUCAID是一个用于肺癌精准病理学的智能多模态AI系统，集成了从质量控制到报告生成的九个诊断模块，在前瞻性临床验证中与专家病理学家达到了高一致性。
summary_zh: 肺癌组织诊断极为复杂，因为精准肿瘤学中的治疗决策依赖于组织形态学、免疫组化及分子特征的整合。然而，病理学评估仍以视觉和半定量方法为主，存在观察者间变异性，而现有的人工智能（AI）工具仅覆盖部分任务，鲜少达到可推广的专家级性能，且缺乏前瞻性临床验证。为应对这些挑战，我们开发并临床验证了LUCAID——一种用于精准肺癌病理学的代理式AI系统。该系统通过一个集成代理将诊断推理与九个模块相耦合，覆盖完整常规工作流程：从质量控制、肿瘤检测与分割、组织学亚型分类、肿瘤微环境分析、肿瘤细胞占比量化、预测性生物标志物评分（PD-L1、MET、TROP-2），到自动化结构化报告生成。LUCAID支持用户交互式查询模块输出结果，并生成将结果置于具体情境中的报告。基于大规模专家真实标注，各分析模块的F1分数达到0.82-0.95。在前瞻性临床验证中，面对临床可操作决策，LUCAID与专家委员会裁定的参考标准一致性达93.0%，而五位经验丰富的胸部病理学家的一致性为68.3-81.1%。

title: ReGround-Surg: Reliability-Guided Anchor Grounding for Referring Surgical Video Segmentation
summary: Referring surgical video segmentation requires segmenting a target instrument or tissue region across video frames according to a natural language expression. Recent Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) based two-stage methods (e.g., ReSurgSAM2) first ground the referred target in an initial or selected frame, then propagate the selected mask via tracking. Although effective, their performance is highly sensitive to the quality of the initial grounded mask: once an incorrect anchor is selected, subsequent tracking tends to propagate the error. This issue is especially challenging in surgical videos due to visually similar instruments, occlusion, and complex tissue-tool interactions. To address this issue, we propose ReGround-Surg, a lightweight reliability-guided anchor grounding framework to improve SAM2-based referring surgical video segmentation. It first predicts a text-conditioned spatial reliability map from the referring expression and current-frame visual features. The map is then reused in two complementary branches: a Gated Side Adapter enhances expression-relevant visual regions before text-to-vision fusion, while a Reliability-Weighted Vision-to-Text Attention module suppresses off-target visual evidence during prompt-token aggregation. Experiments on Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods across three evaluation splits with negligible speed reduction. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/JiaxinWen1/ReGround-Surg.
tldr: ReGround-Surg introduces a reliability-guided anchor grounding framework to improve referring surgical video segmentation by predicting text-conditioned reliability maps that enhance relevant visual regions and suppress off-target evidence, achieving consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods.
tldr_zh: ReGround-Surg 提出了一种可靠性引导的锚点定位框架，通过预测文本条件空间可靠性图来增强相关视觉区域并抑制非目标证据，从而改进手术视频的指代分割，在多个基准上一致优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 指代性手术视频分割需要根据自然语言表达式，在视频帧中分割出目标器械或组织区域。近期基于Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2）的两阶段方法（例如ReSurgSAM2）首先在初始帧或选定帧中定位所指目标，然后通过跟踪传播所选掩码。尽管有效，但其性能对初始定位掩码的质量高度敏感：一旦选择了错误的锚点，后续跟踪往往会传播该错误。由于手术视频中存在视觉相似的器械、遮挡以及复杂的组织-工具交互，这一问题尤其具有挑战性。为解决此问题，我们提出ReGround-Surg，一种轻量级的可靠性引导锚点定位框架，用于改进基于SAM2的指代性手术视频分割。它首先从指代表达式和当前帧视觉特征中预测一个文本条件空间可靠性图。该图随后在两个互补分支中复用：门控侧适配器（Gated Side Adapter）在文本到视觉融合前增强与表达相关的视觉区域，而可靠性加权视觉到文本注意力（Reliability-Weighted Vision-to-Text Attention）模块在提示令牌聚合过程中抑制偏离目标的视觉证据。在Ref-EndoVis17和Ref-EndoVis18上的实验表明，在三个评估划分中，该方法相较现有最优方法均有一致改进，且速度下降可忽略不计。代码已公开于https://github.com/JiaxinWen1/ReGround-Surg。

title: Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation of SAM for Surgical Instrument Segmentation
summary: Surgical instrument segmentation (SIS) is fundamental for computer-assisted surgery, where reliable instrument masks enable precise scene understanding and clinical assistance. Recently, adapting foundation models like the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to the surgical domain via prompt-learning has shown encouraging results. However, the performance of these adapted models under challenging surgical conditions is constrained by suboptimal adaptation mechanisms. Specifically, optimizing prompts or prototypes purely via downstream segmentation loss tends to cause them to degenerate into task-specific parameters rather than serving as persistent, stable category memory, thereby degrading their robustness against complex intraoperative variations. Moreover, routing multi-scale visual cues through a single prompt pathway creates a bottleneck that hinders effective scale-matched coupling. To address these limitations, we propose HPMA, a Hierarchical Prototype-Memory Adaptation framework for SAM. Specifically, HPMA constructs a frozen, multi-scale visual prototype memory bank from annotated surgical scenes and integrates it into SAM's feature space using lightweight adapters to preserve stable category evidence. To maximize the utility of multi-scale cues, we introduce a scale-matched coupling mechanism where global prototypes calibrate class-level prompt features, structural prototypes guide decoder object queries, and local prototypes align high-resolution feature maps through a local alignment objective. Extensive experiments on the public EndoVis2017 and EndoVis2018 datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing foundation model adaptation methods.
tldr: Proposes HPMA, a hierarchical prototype-memory adaptation framework for SAM that constructs a frozen multi-scale visual prototype memory bank and introduces scale-matched coupling to improve surgical instrument segmentation under challenging conditions, achieving state-of-the-art on EndoVis2017/2018.
tldr_zh: 提出HPMA，一种用于SAM的层次化原型记忆适应框架，构建冻结的多尺度视觉原型记忆库并引入尺度匹配耦合机制，在挑战性条件下提升手术器械分割性能，在EndoVis2017/2018上达到最先进水平。
summary_zh: 手术器械分割（SIS）是计算机辅助手术的基础，可靠的器械掩膜能够实现精确的场景理解与临床辅助。近年来，通过提示学习将基础模型（如Segment Anything Model, SAM）适配至手术领域已展现出令人鼓舞的成果。然而，在复杂手术条件下，这些适配模型的性能受限于次优的适配机制。具体而言，仅通过下游分割损失优化提示或原型，易使其退化为任务特定参数，而非充当持久、稳定的类别记忆，从而削弱其对术中复杂变异的鲁棒性。此外，通过单一提示路径路由多尺度视觉线索会造成瓶颈，阻碍有效的尺度匹配耦合。为解决这些局限，我们提出HPMA——一种面向SAM的层级原型记忆适配框架。具体而言，HPMA从标注的手术场景中构建冻结的多尺度视觉原型记忆库，并通过轻量适配器将其集成至SAM的特征空间，以保留稳定的类别证据。为最大化多尺度线索的效用，我们引入尺度匹配耦合机制：全局原型校准类别级提示特征，结构原型引导解码器目标查询，局部原型通过局部对齐目标对齐高分辨率特征图。在公开的EndoVis2017与EndoVis2018数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能，超越了现有基础模型适配方法。

title: ZODIAC: Zero-shot Octree-based Diffusion for Anatomical Completion
summary: Recovering the full 3D spine anatomy from intraoperative ultrasound is an ill-posed inverse problem, as the complete structure must be inferred from incomplete and noisy observations. Acoustic occlusions and limited field of view create large unobserved regions, while view-dependent artifacts lead to variability in expert annotations of the visible anatomy. Current supervised ultrasound shape completion methods rely on synthetically generated incomplete-complete paired data to learn conditional mappings under a predefined distribution of simulated occlusions. However, real intraoperative occlusions do not necessarily follow this distribution, which can limit generalization to patient data. As a result, accurate and robust completion from noisy partial observations remains an unsolved problem. We propose a zero-shot shape completion framework that reconstructs the entire lumbar spine from partial ultrasound observations without relying on simulated training data. To accommodate unseen and irregular patterns of missing structures, we introduce blended completion, a mechanism that integrates the learned anatomical prior with incoming partial geometry at inference time. The method learns a generative diffusion prior over full anatomical shapes represented in an adaptive octree structure, enabling efficient modeling of the complete spine in a single forward pass. Validation on phantom and volunteer data shows that decoupling completion from a predefined corruption distribution improves generalisation under real occlusions, outperforming a fully supervised variant by 22% on HD95 completion error. Code and data are available at https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC.
tldr: ZODIAC is a zero-shot shape completion framework that reconstructs the full 3D lumbar spine from partial intraoperative ultrasound observations using a diffusion prior learned on complete anatomies represented in an adaptive octree structure, without relying on simulated training data.
tldr_zh: ZODIAC是一种零样本形状补全框架，通过在学习完整解剖结构的扩散先验上结合自适应八叉树表示，从部分术中超声观测中重建完整的3D腰椎，无需依赖模拟训练数据。
summary_zh: 从术中超声恢复完整的3D脊柱解剖结构是一个不适定逆问题，因为必须从不完整且含有噪声的观测中推断出完整结构。声遮挡和有限的视野造成了大量未观测区域，而视角相关的伪影则导致专家对可见解剖结构的标注存在变异性。当前的监督式超声形状补全方法依赖于合成生成的不完整-完整配对数据，在预定义的模拟遮挡分布下学习条件映射。然而，真实的术中遮挡不一定遵循该分布，这可能会限制对患者数据的泛化能力。因此，从含有噪声的部分观测中实现准确且鲁棒的补全仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们提出了一种零样本形状补全框架，该框架无需依赖模拟训练数据，即可从部分超声观测中重建整个腰椎。为了适应未见过的和不规则的缺失结构模式，我们引入了混合补全机制，该机制在推理时将学习到的解剖先验与输入的部分几何结构相结合。该方法学习了一个针对完整解剖形状（以自适应八叉树结构表示）的生成扩散先验，从而能够在单次前向传播中高效建模完整的脊柱。在体模和志愿者数据上的验证表明，将补全过程与预定义的退化分布解耦，提高了在真实遮挡下的泛化能力，在HD95补全误差上比全监督变体高出22%。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/miruna20/ZODIAC 获取。

title: Neurosymbolic Alignment for Physiologically-Safe Clinical Language Models
summary: Clinical LLMs can generate recommendations that are factually plausible yet physiologically unsafe. We investigate whether safety alignment can be improved by grounding preference optimization in structured physiological knowledge rather than text-only supervision. Methods: We propose Neurosymbolic Alignment, a training-time framework that couples a 7B clinical LLM with an HGNN-based Physiological World Model over an 847K-node biomedical knowledge graph. Candidate responses are scored using homeostatic constraints, multi-hop path plausibility, and drug-interaction penalties, and the resulting rankings drive iterative on-policy ORPO updates. Evaluation is performed on the Clinical Safety Benchmark (CSB), a 2,500-scenario benchmark for physiological constraint violations in generative clinical reasoning. Results: Relative to ORPO, the proposed method improves CSS from 69.5% to 90.8% (+21.3 pp), reduces physician-evaluated HR from 14.1% to 5.1% on the blinded subset, and improves DID from 72.8% to 91.6%. These gains are corroborated by an HGNN-independent Rule-Engine Safety Score (RSS: 86.4%, +21.2 pp over ORPO; r=0.97 concordance with CSS). The method also exceeds GPT-4 (5-shot) on all safety metrics despite a 10x parameter disadvantage, and outperforms an inference-time self-correction pipeline (SFT+SelfCorrect) by 11.4 pp CSS. Under synthetic EHR-style noise, 84.2% CSS is retained. Ablation analysis shows that HGNN scoring (-16.2 pp) and iterative training (-11.5 pp) are the dominant contributors. PhysioScore calibration against 200 clinician labels yielded ECE = 0.038 and kappa = 0.91. Conclusion: Training-time physiological grounding produces measurable and independently verifiable safety improvements in open-weight clinical LLMs under controlled evaluation. External validation on real clinical data is required to determine whether these gains transfer to deployment settings
tldr: The paper proposes Neurosymbolic Alignment, a training-time framework that grounds clinical LLM safety alignment in structured physiological knowledge (via an HGNN-based world model and knowledge graph) rather than text-only supervision, achieving significant improvements in safety metrics over baselines and even outperforming GPT-4 in controlled evaluations.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种神经符号对齐框架，通过在训练时将临床大语言模型的安全对齐建立在结构化生理知识（基于HGNN的世界模型和知识图谱）之上，而非仅依赖文本监督，在安全指标上显著优于基线模型，甚至在受控评估中超越GPT-4。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
临床大语言模型可能生成在事实上看似合理但在生理上不安全的建议。我们研究是否可以通过将偏好优化基于结构化生理知识而非纯文本监督来提升安全对齐效果。方法：我们提出神经符号对齐框架，这是一种训练时方法，将7B参数的临床LLM与基于HGNN的生理世界模型相结合，该模型构建于一个包含847K节点的生物医学知识图谱上。候选回答通过稳态约束、多跳路径合理性和药物相互作用惩罚进行评分，所得排名驱动迭代式在策略ORPO更新。评估在临床安全基准（CSB）上进行，该基准包含2,500个用于检测生成性临床推理中生理约束违反的场景。结果：与ORPO相比，所提方法将CSS从69.5%提升至90.8%（+21.3个百分点），在盲法子集中将医生评估的HR从14.1%降至5.1%，并将DID从72.8%提升至91.6%。这些改进通过独立于HGNN的规则引擎安全分数（RSS：86.4%，比ORPO高21.2个百分点；与CSS的一致性r=0.97）得到证实。尽管参数数量少10倍，该方法在所有安全指标上均超过GPT-4（5次样本），并比推理时自我修正流水线（SFT+SelfCorrect）高出11.4个百分点的CSS。在合成EHR风格噪声下，保留了84.2%的CSS。消融分析显示，HGNN评分（-16.2个百分点）和迭代训练（-11.5个百分点）是主要贡献因素。PhysioScore与200名临床医生标注的校准结果：ECE=0.038，kappa=0.91。结论：在受控评估条件下，训练时的生理基础可在开放权重临床LLM中产生可量化且独立可验证的安全改进。需要在真实临床数据上进行外部验证，以确定这些改进是否能迁移至部署环境。

title: MoE-based Feature Adapter for Prompt-free Binary Coronary Artery Segmentation in X-ray Angiography
summary: Accurate segmentation of coronary arteries in X-ray angiography videos is essential for quantitative coronary analysis and image-guided interventions. However, accurate segmentation remains challenging because coronary vessels are thin and exhibit low contrast, while the presence of catheters, guidewires, and complex anatomical background structures can further interfere with vessel delineation. Existing U-Net- and Transformer-based models provide strong baselines, but their shared feature-adaptation pathways may be insufficient for heterogeneous angiographic appearances. In this paper, we propose a prompt-free mixture-of-experts (MoE) feature adapter for binary coronary artery segmentation. Built upon parameter-efficient Vision Transformer adapters, the proposed method uses multiple lightweight experts with input-dependent top-$k$ routing to adaptively refine vessel-related features while limiting active computational cost. Experiments on MOSXAV and external evaluation on XACV show that the proposed method outperforms representative baselines and improves cross-dataset generalisation. These results suggest that MoE-based adapter learning is effective for robust coronary artery segmentation in X-ray angiography videos.
tldr: Proposes a prompt-free MoE feature adapter for binary coronary artery segmentation in X-ray angiography, using multiple lightweight experts with top-k routing to adaptively refine vessel-related features, outperforming baselines and improving cross-dataset generalization.
tldr_zh: 提出一种无需提示的混合专家特征适配器，用于X射线血管造影中的冠状动脉二元分割，通过多个轻量级专家和top-k路由自适应优化血管相关特征，优于基线方法并提升跨数据集泛化能力。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在X射线血管造影视频中准确分割冠状动脉对于定量冠状动脉分析和图像引导介入治疗至关重要。然而，由于冠状动脉血管纤细且对比度低，同时导管、导丝以及复杂的解剖背景结构会进一步干扰血管勾画，准确分割仍面临挑战。现有基于U-Net和Transformer的模型提供了强基线，但其共享特征适配路径可能不足以应对异质性血管造影表现。本文提出了一种无提示的混合专家（MoE）特征适配器用于二值冠状动脉分割。该方法构建于参数高效的Vision Transformer适配器之上，使用多个轻量级专家并结合依赖输入的top-k路由，在限制活跃计算成本的同时自适应地优化与血管相关的特征。在MOSXAV上的实验以及XACV上的外部评估表明，所提方法优于代表性基线，并提升了跨数据集的泛化能力。这些结果提示，基于MoE的适配器学习对于X射线血管造影视频中的鲁棒冠状动脉分割是有效的。

title: DRRG: A Discrete Diffusion Framework for Radiology Report Generation
summary:
Purpose: Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) has been widely explored to improve reporting accuracy and reduce radiologists' workload. Most existing methods rely on autoregressive (AR) frameworks that generate reports token by token and cannot revise earlier content, making them prone to error propagation and inconsistent with the iterative refinement process of radiological reporting. In contrast, discrete diffusion large language models (DLLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, naturally enabling report refinement. However, DLLMs have not been extensively investigated for RRG. In this study, we developed and evaluated a discrete diffusion framework for RRG that enables iterative refinement rather than conventional left-to-right autoregressive decoding.
  Materials and methods: We developed DRRG, a DLLM-based framework that formulates RRG as iterative masked-token denoising. DRRG incorporates a clinical-entities-aware complementary mask to improve token supervision coverage and emphasize clinically important entities, together with a concept-conditioning module that injects image-derived clinical concepts into visual representations. DRRG was trained and evaluated on MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus.
  Results: On MIMIC-CXR, DRRG achieved BLEU-4 of 0.210, CheXpert-F1 of 0.549, RadGraph-F1 of 0.281, GREEN of 0.360, and RaTEScore of 0.604, outperforming the compared methods on most reported metrics, despite employing a substantially smaller LLM decoder. On CheXpert Plus, DRRG achieved the highest BLEU-4 (0.119) and CheXpert-F1 (0.347) among the compared methods.
  Conclusion: Discrete diffusion provides an effective alternative to autoregressive radiology report generation by enabling iterative, bidirectional report refinement. Incorporating clinically focused masking and image-derived concept conditioning improves report quality and clinical consistency.
tldr: The paper proposes DRRG, a discrete diffusion framework for radiology report generation that enables iterative refinement via masked-token denoising, incorporating a clinical-entities-aware mask and image-derived concept conditioning, achieving state-of-the-art results on MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出DRRG，一种用于放射学报告生成的离散扩散框架，通过掩码标记去噪实现迭代优化，结合临床实体感知掩码和图像派生概念调节，在MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus数据集上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh:
摘要  
目的：自动放射学报告生成（RRG）已被广泛研究，旨在提高报告准确性并减轻放射科医师的工作负担。现有方法大多依赖自回归（AR）框架，逐词生成报告且无法修正先前内容，容易导致错误传播，且不符合放射学报告不断迭代修订的实际过程。相比之下，离散扩散大语言模型（DLLM）通过迭代去噪生成文本，天然支持报告的修订优化。然而，DLLM在RRG领域尚未得到充分探索。本研究开发并评估了一种用于RRG的离散扩散框架，该框架支持迭代修订，而非传统的从左到右自回归解码。  

材料与方法：我们开发了DRRG——一种基于DLLM的框架，将RRG建模为迭代掩码标记去噪任务。DRRG引入了临床实体感知的互补掩码，以提高标记监督覆盖率并强调临床重要的实体，同时配备概念条件模块，将源自图像的临床概念注入视觉表示。DRRG在MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus数据集上进行了训练和评估。  

结果：在MIMIC-CXR上，DRRG的BLEU-4为0.210，CheXpert-F1为0.549，RadGraph-F1为0.281，GREEN为0.360，RaTEScore为0.604，尽管使用了规模明显更小的LLM解码器，但在大多数报告指标上均优于对比方法。在CheXpert Plus上，DRRG在对比方法中取得了最高的BLEU-4（0.119）和CheXpert-F1（0.347）。  

结论：离散扩散通过支持迭代、双向的报告修订，为自回归放射学报告生成提供了一种有效替代方案。结合临床聚焦的掩码及图像导出的概念条件化，能够提升报告质量与临床一致性。

title: LUX: A Lesion-Aware Graph-Conditioned Visual - Language Architecture for Explainable Endoscopic Captioning
summary:
The interpretation of endoscopic imagery in ulcerative colitis is complex and subjective, with variability in human assessment and subtle mucosal inflammation. Although deep learning has advanced automated analysis, most vision-language models rely on global visual embeddings that overlook the localized and relational nature of pathological evidence, limiting clinical reliability and interpretability.
  We introduce LUX (Lesion-aware Unified eXplainable captioning), a graph-conditioned vision-language architecture for explainable endoscopic image captioning. LUX constructs a lesion-centric scene graph from Grad-CAM and CBAM activation maps, representing pathological regions as nodes and encoding their spatial and clinical relationships. These graph embeddings are integrated into the cross-attention layers of a T5 decoder, enabling generated words to attend to specific lesion nodes rather than only to global image features. This provides direct alignment between linguistic content and pathological evidence, supporting token-level interpretability and relational reasoning.
  LUX outperforms strong baseline and state-of-the-art medical captioning models across BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr, with particularly strong gains in CIDEr. It also reduces hallucinated clinical findings and improves lesion-level grounding through stronger correspondence between generated tokens and localized pathological regions.
tldr: Proposes LUX, a graph-conditioned vision-language model that constructs lesion-centric scene graphs from activation maps to improve explainable endoscopic captioning, achieving state-of-the-art results and reducing hallucination.
tldr_zh: 提出LUX，一种基于图的条件视觉语言模型，通过从激活图构建病灶中心场景图来改进可解释的内窥镜图像描述，达到最先进水平并减少幻觉。
summary_zh:
摘要：
溃疡性结肠炎的内镜图像判读复杂且主观，人类评估存在变异性且黏膜炎症表现细微。尽管深度学习推动了自动化分析，但大多数视觉-语言模型依赖全局视觉嵌入，忽视了病理证据的局部性和关系性，限制了临床可靠性和可解释性。

我们提出LUX（病灶感知统一可解释图像描述）——一种用于可解释内镜图像描述的图条件视觉-语言架构。LUX从Grad-CAM和CBAM激活图构建以病灶为中心的场景图，将病理区域表示为节点并编码其空间与临床关系。这些图嵌入被集成到T5解码器的交叉注意力层中，使生成的词语能够关注特定病灶节点而非仅关注全局图像特征。这实现了语言内容与病理证据的直接对齐，支持词元级可解释性和关系推理。

LUX在BLEU、METEOR、ROUGE-L和CIDEr指标上均优于强基线和最先进的医学图像描述模型，尤其在CIDEr上提升显著。通过增强生成词元与局部病理区域之间的对应关系，LUX还减少了幻觉临床发现并改善了病灶级对齐。

title: Beyond Information Seeking: Severity-Aware Question Supervision for Proactive Medical Dialogue
summary: Proactive medical dialogue requires an agent to decide what to ask from incomplete patient information. Existing information-seeking approaches commonly prioritize questions that most reduce diagnostic uncertainty. While effective for acquiring informative evidence, this criterion overlooks an important property of medical diagnosis: different diagnostic errors can carry substantially different consequences. Missing a severe condition may matter more than reducing uncertainty among less consequential alternatives. Question acquisition should therefore consider not only how informative new evidence is, but also how it is expected to affect the downstream diagnostic decision. To this end, we propose Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a consequence-aware question-supervision objective that values each candidate by its expected reduction in severity-aware terminal risk. Because questions must be selected before their answers are observed, ESR marginalizes over possible answers using train-only population statistics. Its rankings are then distilled into a prefix-only language policy, so next-question selection requires no teacher-side computation at deployment. Across three Qwen3-4B training seeds on DDxPlus, matched ESR supervision reduces mean high-severity diagnostic miss from .0645 to .0455 (-29.5%) and improves mean diagnostic accuracy from .9123 to .9320 while requiring only 0.14 additional questions per dialogue. Fixed-budget analyses show that the two objectives remain behaviorally distinct when question count is controlled, while a matched expected-0/1-risk control shows that severity-aware weighting improves the high-severity error profile beyond generic decision-aware supervision. These results support moving proactive medical dialogue beyond uncertainty reduction toward consequence-aware evidence acquisition.
tldr: This paper proposes Expected-Severity-Risk (ESR), a severity-aware question supervision objective for proactive medical dialogue that prioritizes questions reducing the risk of missing severe conditions, rather than merely reducing diagnostic uncertainty. Experiments on DDxPlus show ESR reduces high-severity diagnostic miss by 29.5% and improves accuracy with minimal extra questions, demonstrating the value of consequence-aware evidence acquisition.
tldr_zh: 本文提出预期严重性风险（ESR），一种用于主动医疗对话的严重性感知问题监督目标，优先选择能降低遗漏严重疾病风险的问题，而非仅仅减少诊断不确定性。在DDxPlus上的实验显示，ESR将高严重性诊断遗漏率降低29.5%，并在仅增加极少提问的情况下提高了准确率，证明了后果感知证据获取的价值。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
主动性医疗对话要求智能体在不完整的患者信息基础上决定应提出哪些问题。现有信息获取方法通常优先选择最能降低诊断不确定性的问题。虽然这对获取有效证据很有效，但这一标准忽略了医疗诊断的一个重要特性：不同的诊断错误可能带来截然不同的后果。遗漏严重病情的后果可能比在不太重要的备选方案中降低不确定性更为重要。因此，问题获取不仅应考虑新证据的信息量，还应考虑其预计如何影响下游诊断决策。为此，我们提出期望严重性风险（ESR），这是一种考虑后果的问题监督目标，根据每个候选问题对严重性感知终端风险的预期降低程度来评估其价值。由于必须在观察到答案之前选择问题，ESR 使用仅训练集的群体统计量对可能的答案进行边缘化处理。然后，其排序结果被提炼为仅前缀语言策略，使得在部署时下一个问题的选择无需教师端计算。在 DDxPlus 上使用三个 Qwen3-4B 训练种子的实验中，匹配的 ESR 监督将平均高严重性诊断遗漏率从 0.0645 降至 0.0455（-29.5%），并将平均诊断准确率从 0.9123 提升至 0.9320，同时每次对话仅需额外提出 0.14 个问题。固定预算分析表明，当问题数量受控时，这两个目标在行为上仍存在显著差异；而匹配的期望 0/1 风险对照实验表明，严重性感知加权在改善高严重性错误表现方面优于泛化决策感知监督。这些结果支持将主动性医疗对话从降低不确定性进一步拓展至考虑后果的证据获取。

title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove for High Performance Dexterous Manipulation Capture
summary: Capturing hand pose during dexterous manipulation remains difficult: vision-based methods degrade under occlusion and challenging lighting, while sensorized gloves, though occlusion-free, are prone to drift and magnetic interference and rarely match motion-capture accuracy. We introduce a fiber optic sensing glove for full hand pose tracking that targets these failure modes, using multi-core shape-sensing fibers that capture each fiber's full 3D shape rather than curvature alone. A novel pipeline registers each reconstructed fiber shape to a common hand reference frame, and a new inverse-kinematics solver reconstructs full hand pose at 60 Hz using curve constraints. Benchmarked on a 2-hour dataset of dexterous object manipulation tasks across 5 subjects, the glove achieves 7.2 mm mean fingertip position error against motion capture ground truth, reduced to 4.9 mm by a one-time factory calibration of the fiber routing hub that transfers across users and sessions. These capabilities enable high-fidelity data capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation - both essential to advancing the robotics field.
tldr: A fiber optic sensing glove using multi-core shape-sensing fibers achieves high-fidelity hand pose tracking (7.2 mm mean fingertip error) free from occlusion and drift, with a novel shape registration and inverse-kinematics pipeline, enabling bimanual teleoperation for robotics.
tldr_zh: 一种采用多芯形状传感光纤的手套，实现了无遮挡和漂移的高保真手部姿态追踪（平均指尖误差7.2毫米），通过新颖的形状配准和逆运动学管线，支持机器人双手遥操作。
summary_zh: 摘要：灵巧操作过程中的手部姿态捕捉仍存在困难：基于视觉的方法在遮挡和光照不佳条件下性能下降；而传感手套虽不受遮挡影响，但易受漂移和磁干扰，且极少能达到运动捕捉的精度。我们提出一种用于全手姿态追踪的光纤传感手套，针对上述失效模式，采用多芯形状传感光纤，可捕捉每根光纤的完整3D形状而非仅曲率信息。一条新流程将每根重建的光纤形状注册到统一的手部参考框架，并通过一种新型逆运动学求解器，利用曲线约束以60 Hz频率重建全手姿态。在涵盖5名受试者、2小时的灵巧物体操作任务数据集上进行基准测试，该手套相对于运动捕捉真值的平均指尖位置误差为7.2 mm；通过对光纤路由集线器进行一次性出厂标定（该标定可跨用户和会话复用），误差降至4.9 mm。这些能力实现了高保真数据采集和双臂虚拟遥操作——两者对于推动机器人领域发展均至关重要。

title: Generating Biomedical Fact-Checking Reports with RL-Enhanced Agentic Search
summary: Automated fact-checking is essential for ensuring the reliability of public health information, yet the biomedical domain poses unique challenges. Validating biomedical claims requires rigorous interpretation of scientific literature, assessment of retrieved evidence, and comprehensive justification toward the conclusion. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) enhanced by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic search perform automated fact-checking in a retrieve-then-verify paradigm, current methods still output isolated prediction labels, lacking explanatory depth and offers limited utility for human understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce an LLM-based agent named BioCheck Agent that generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports with agentic search. Rather than merely outputting supported or refuted labels, our agent synthesizes final conclusions with retrieved evidence and rigorous analysis. To ensure domain-specific accuracy, BioCheck Agent exclusively searches high-quality scientific literature in PubMed, utilizing advanced Boolean search operators. Recognizing that direct prompting often results in hallucinations and low-quality reports, especially for lightweight open-source models, we further propose the Evidence-Grounded Group Relative Policy Optimization (EG-GRPO) to perform reinforcement learning on BioCheck Agent with a task-specific reward that incentivizes advanced search behavior and high-quality evidence retrieval while penalizing hallucinations. Our experimental results show that compared to the base model Qwen3.5-4B, BioCheck Agent with EG-GRPO improves label prediction accuracy on SciFact by 9.95%. Furthermore, it achieves a 3.7% higher evidence quality score and a 19.63% lower evidence hallucination rate, demonstrating its ability to generate biomedical fact-checking reports with improved accuracy and quality.
tldr: This paper introduces BioCheck Agent, an LLM-based agent that generates structured biomedical fact-checking reports using agentic search and reinforcement learning (EG-GRPO), improving accuracy and reducing hallucinations compared to base models.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于LLM的代理BioCheck Agent，通过代理搜索和强化学习（EG-GRPO）生成结构化的生物医学事实核查报告，相比基础模型提高了准确率并减少了幻觉。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
自动事实核查对于保障公共卫生信息的可靠性至关重要，但生物医学领域带来了独特挑战。验证生物医学主张需要严谨解读科学文献、评估检索证据，并针对结论提供全面论证。尽管通过检索增强生成（RAG）和智能体搜索增强的大语言模型（LLMs）能够以“检索-验证”范式执行自动事实核查，但当前方法仍仅输出孤立预测标签，缺乏解释深度，对人类理解的辅助作用有限。为弥补这一不足，我们提出一种基于LLM的智能体——BioCheck智能体，能够通过智能体搜索生成结构化的生物医学事实核查报告。该智能体并非仅输出“支持”或“反驳”标签，而是综合检索证据与严谨分析形成最终结论。为确保领域特异性准确，BioCheck智能体仅检索PubMed中的高质量科学文献，并利用高级布尔搜索运算符。鉴于直接提示常导致轻量级开源模型产生幻觉和低质量报告，我们进一步提出基于证据的组相对策略优化（EG-GRPO），通过对BioCheck智能体实施带有任务特定奖励的强化学习，激励高级搜索行为与高质量证据检索，同时惩罚幻觉。实验结果表明，与基础模型Qwen3.5-4B相比，采用EG-GRPO的BioCheck智能体在SciFact数据集上的标签预测准确率提升了9.95%。此外，其证据质量评分提高了3.7%，证据幻觉率降低了19.63%，证明了其在生成准确且高质量的生物医学事实核查报告方面的能力。

title: Speech-to-SOAP: End-to-End Summarization of Medical Dialogues: KIT@BeTraC 2026
summary: With the advent of Large Language Models and its instruction following capabilities a promising application is the task of summarization. Within this domain of task the extractive sub-task of clinical protocolling has emerged as a topic of particular interest as it can significantly reduce the downtime and protocolling burden of health-care workers thus enabling them to focus on their core work helping humans. A further step towards automation is the direct generation of clinical notes from speech without intermediate transcripts, reducing processing time while preserving information such as coughing or other paralinguistic cues that may be lost in transcript-based systems. To this end, we present KIT's submission to this years BeTraC challenge in the lightweight track. Our main contribution is a scalable data augmentation pipeline that unifies heterogeneous medical dialogue datasets through synthetic speech generation and automatically generated SOAP supervision, enabling robust adaptation of a speech foundation model for end-to-end speech-to-SOAP generation.
tldr: KIT's submission to the BeTraC 2026 challenge presents an end-to-end speech-to-SOAP summarization system that uses a scalable data augmentation pipeline with synthetic speech and automatic SOAP supervision to adapt a speech foundation model for generating clinical notes directly from audio.
tldr_zh: KIT团队向BeTraC 2026挑战赛提交的端到端语音到SOAP摘要系统，通过可扩展的数据增强流水线（包含合成语音和自动SOAP监督），使语音基础模型能够直接从音频生成临床笔记。
summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型及其指令遵循能力的出现，摘要任务成为一项前景广阔的应用。在这一任务领域中，临床协议的提取子任务已成为特别受关注的话题，因为它能显著减少医护人员的非工作时间与协议负担，从而使其能够专注于帮助病患的核心工作。迈向自动化的进一步步骤是直接从语音生成临床笔记，无需中间转录，从而在缩短处理时间的同时保留咳嗽等副语言线索，而这些信息在基于转录的系统中可能会丢失。为此，我们提交了KIT在本次BeTraC挑战赛轻量级赛道中的方案。我们的主要贡献是一个可扩展的数据增强管道，该管道通过合成语音生成与自动生成的SOAP监督，统一了异构医学对话数据集，从而实现了语音基础模型针对端到端语音到SOAP生成的鲁棒适应。

title: Right Diagnoses, Decorative Reasoning:A Perturbation Audit of Medical Chain-of-Thought
summary: Clinicians read chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales as evidence of medical reasoning, but whether the visible chain plays that role is rarely tested. General-domain CoT-faithfulness probes ignore clinical cost, and medical LLM evaluations treat the chain as a black box. We close this gap with a medical perturbation audit: a 30-operator battery edits both the chain and the question with clinically motivated operators (severity reversal, negation flip, demographic swap, evidence ablation), paired with a chain-update times answer-flip joint analysis that classifies each model by its failure mode. Applied to 14 LLMs on four medical QA benchmarks, three independent tests converge: the Chain-Decoupling Rate (CDR; chain does not register the edit and the answer does not flip) is 72.9% panel-wide on clinically meaningful destructive edits, chain corruption leaves accuracy unchanged, and removing CoT prompting does not reduce accuracy. Two board-certified clinicians re-annotate N=197 perturbed questions; 98.5% leave the gold defensible. The pattern holds across medical and reasoning fine-tuning and scale; on the closed-source tier, where the chain text is unavailable, the answer-side signals are consistent with the same decoupling. Our framework and CDR provide a reusable yardstick for auditing whether medical CoT is faithful or merely documentation.
tldr: This paper introduces a perturbation audit to test whether chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in medical LLMs is faithful or decorative, finding that across 14 models the chain often fails to track edits and accuracy does not rely on CoT.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种扰动审计方法，检验医疗大语言模型中的思维链（CoT）推理是否忠实或仅为装饰，发现14个模型中思维链常无法响应编辑，且准确性不依赖CoT。
summary_zh:
摘要：
临床医生将思维链（CoT）推理依据视为医学推理的证据，但可见的思维链是否真正发挥这一作用却鲜有检验。通用领域的CoT真实性探测忽略了临床成本，而医学大语言模型评估则将思维链视为黑箱。我们通过医学扰动审计填补了这一空白：一套包含30个操作算子的工具包，利用临床驱动的算子（严重性反转、否定翻转、人口统计学属性置换、证据消融）对思维链和问题同时进行编辑，并结合链更新与答案翻转的联合分析，按失效模式对每个模型进行分类。在四个医学问答基准上对14个大语言模型进行测试后，三项独立检验结果趋于一致：在临床有意义的破坏性编辑下，全局范围内的链解耦率（CDR；即编辑未被链记录且答案未翻转）为72.9%；链被篡改后准确率保持不变；移除CoT提示后准确率也未下降。两位委员会认证的临床医生对N=197个扰动问题进行重新标注，其中98.5%的问题的金标准仍然合理。该模式在医学与推理微调及模型规模上均保持一致；在闭源模型层级（无法获取思维链文本时），答案侧信号同样支持相同的解耦现象。我们的框架和CDR为审计医学CoT是真实推理还是仅为文档记录提供了可复用的度量标准。

title: B-MIM: Biased Masked Image Modeling for Generalizable Segmentation of Fine-Grained Anatomical Structures
summary: Self-supervised pretraining enables transferable representations for medical imaging, yet most CT encoders remain biased toward coarse semantic understanding, limiting their sensitivity to fine-grained anatomical structures such as vessels or small tumors. In this paper, we introduce Biased Masked Image Modeling (B-MIM), a modification of the iBOT objective that stochastically reduces global semantic alignment to prioritize local patch reconstruction. This bias encourages the encoder to capture high-frequency morphological details and structural continuity. We curate a multi-institutional CT abdominal dataset of 9,955 filtered studies from 17 public sources and pretrain a 3D Swin Transformer backbone using B-MIM. Across inter-dataset experiments on liver vessel segmentation, the proposed encoder improves topological fidelity (clDice) and achieves competitive Dice scores in tumor segmentation, compared to fully fine-tuned baselines, despite updating only a fraction of the parameters. Our results suggest that reducing global semantic pressure during pretraining enhances generalization to intricate anatomical structures.
tldr: This paper proposes Biased Masked Image Modeling (B-MIM), a self-supervised pretraining method that reduces global semantic alignment to prioritize local patch reconstruction, improving fine-grained anatomical structure segmentation (e.g., vessels, tumors) in CT images.
tldr_zh: 本文提出偏置掩码图像建模（B-MIM），一种自监督预训练方法，通过减少全局语义对齐而优先重建局部补丁，从而提升CT图像中精细解剖结构（如血管、肿瘤）的分割性能。
summary_zh: 自监督预训练能够为医学影像学提供可迁移表征，但大多数CT编码器仍偏向于粗粒度语义理解，限制了其对血管或微小肿瘤等精细解剖结构的敏感度。本文提出有偏掩码图像建模（B-MIM），该方法对iBOT目标函数进行改进，通过随机降低全局语义对齐的权重，优先强化局部块重建。这种偏置策略促使编码器捕获高频形态细节与结构连续性。我们整合了来自17个公共数据源的9,955例经筛选的多机构CT腹部影像数据集，并采用B-MIM对3D Swin Transformer骨干网络进行预训练。在跨数据集的肝血管分割实验中，尽管仅更新了少量参数，所提编码器仍能提升拓扑保真度（clDice），并在肿瘤分割中达到与完整微调基线相竞争的Dice分数。实验结果表明：降低预训练过程中的全局语义压力能增强模型对复杂解剖结构的泛化能力。

title: Low-Rank Velocity Fields as a Structural Prior for Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
summary: Endpoint-only unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation synthesizes intermediate volumes from sparsely sampled sequences with only the start and end volumes available for training; however, this weakly constrained setting often yields intermediates with unstable boundaries and non-physiological motion, limiting interpretability and downstream analysis. We propose low-rank velocity fields as a structural prior, constraining motion to a structured Tucker low-rank velocity field space that decomposes motion into globally shared spatial bases and a compact sample-specific core, thereby encouraging spatially correlated, anatomy-consistent deformation while suppressing voxel-wise high-frequency artifacts. To capture global coordination and local non-rigid details, we model motion in a coarse-to-fine multi-scale scheme and compose scale-wise deformations at inference to synthesize volumes at arbitrary times. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that, under Tucker parameterization, low-rank parameters control the smoothness energy of the velocity field, explaining why low-rank modeling promotes smoother motion. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, remaining competitive with methods trained with intermediate-frame supervision, and producing intermediates with improved structural coherence and more stable anatomical contours.
tldr: The paper proposes low-rank velocity fields as a structural prior for unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation, using Tucker decomposition to constrain motion, enabling state-of-the-art interpolation with improved structural coherence and stability.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出将低秩速度场作为无监督4D医学图像插值的结构先验，通过Tucker分解约束运动，实现了具有更好结构一致性和稳定性的插值，达到了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 仅端点无监督的4D医学图像插值方法通过稀疏采样的序列合成中间体，训练时仅使用起始和结束体；然而，这种弱约束设置通常会导致中间体出现不稳定的边界和非生理运动，限制了可解释性和下游分析。我们提出将低秩速度场作为结构先验，将运动约束至结构化的Tucker低秩速度场空间，该空间将运动分解为全局共享的空间基和一个紧凑的样本特定核心，从而在抑制体素级高频伪影的同时，促进空间相关且解剖结构一致的变形。为捕捉全局协调性和局部非刚性细节，我们采用由粗到精的多尺度方案对运动进行建模，并在推理时按尺度组合变形以合成任意时刻的体。我们进一步提供了理论分析，表明在Tucker参数化下，低秩参数控制着速度场的平滑能量，解释了为何低秩建模能促进更平滑的运动。在ACDC和4D-Lung上的实验表明，该方法达到了最先进的性能，与使用中间帧监督训练的方法相比仍具竞争力，并且生成的中间体具有更好的结构一致性和更稳定的解剖轮廓。

title: Metadata-Aware Adaptation of a Generative Foundation Model for Conditional CMR Synthesis
summary: Synthetic image generation is a promising strategy to address data scarcity and the underrepresentation of clinically important phenotypes in medical imaging, yet generating images that faithfully reflect meaningful patient characteristics remains challenging. In this work, we investigate metadata-conditioned cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) synthesis using a pretrained latent diffusion model, encoding structured clinical metadata and slice position as textual prompts to guide CMR generation. To improve metadata adherence and address the imbalance of clinical attributes, we integrate three strategies: Metadata-Free Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), Contrastive Batching, and Inverse-Frequency Sampling. The framework was fine-tuned and evaluated on 59,058 short-axis CMR from the UK Biobank using paired image similarity, distributional fidelity, and subgroup-level analyses. The combined approach achieved a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 37.47, improving by 57.04\% over the same model fine-tuned without these strategies and by 28.68\% over a previous text-conditioned CMR diffusion baseline requiring cardiac geometry as additional input, while relying solely on patient metadata. This distributional gain, driven mainly by Metadata-Free CFG, came with a modest reduction in paired similarity, suggesting that the model prioritizes population-level realism over exact image reproduction. Subgroup analyses demonstrated improved alignment across demographic and acquisition-related metadata, with disease-specific conditioning being the most challenging task. These findings demonstrate the potential of generative foundation models for clinically meaningful CMR synthesis while highlighting the need for more effective metadata-aware conditioning strategies. Our code is available at https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/conditional-cmr.
tldr: This paper presents a metadata-conditioned latent diffusion model for cardiac MRI synthesis, employing strategies like Metadata-Free CFG, Contrastive Batching, and Inverse-Frequency Sampling to improve metadata adherence and distributional fidelity, achieving a 57% FID improvement over baseline but with reduced paired similarity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于元数据条件的潜在扩散模型用于心脏MRI合成，采用无元数据CFG、对比批处理、逆频率采样等策略提升元数据遵循度和分布保真度，相比基线实现了57%的FID改善，但配对相似度有所下降。
summary_zh: 合成图像生成是一种有前景的策略，可解决医学影像中数据稀缺及临床重要表型代表性不足的问题，但生成能忠实反映有意义的患者特征的图像仍具挑战。本研究利用预训练的潜在扩散模型，通过将结构化临床元数据和切片位置编码为文本提示来引导心脏磁共振（CMR）合成，探索基于元数据条件化的CMR生成。为提高元数据依从性并应对临床属性不平衡问题，我们整合了三种策略：无元数据分类器自由引导（CFG）、对比批次采样和逆频率采样。该框架基于英国生物银行的59,058张短轴CMR图像进行微调与评估，采用配对图像相似性、分布保真度及亚组分析。组合方法实现了37.47的Fréchet起始距离（FID），较未采用这些策略的同一模型微调结果提升了57.04%，较此前需要心脏几何形状作为额外输入的文本条件化CMR扩散基线提升了28.68%，且仅依赖患者元数据。这种主要由无元数据CFG驱动的分布增益，伴随配对相似性的适度降低，表明模型更注重群体级真实性而非精确图像复现。亚组分析显示，在人口统计学及采集相关元数据方面的一致性有所提升，其中疾病特异性条件化是最具挑战的任务。这些发现证明了生成式基础模型在临床相关CMR合成中的潜力，同时凸显了更有效的元数据感知条件化策略的必要性。我们的代码位于https://github.com/rodriguezmarc/conditional-cmr。

title: Example-based Robust Abnormality Detection with Minimal Annotations using Exemplar Med-DETR
summary: Reducing annotation requirements remains a key challenge in developing robust medical object detectors. To address this, Vision-Language (VL) object detection methods leverage grounding text information to enable powerful zero-shot and few-shot object detectors in the natural image domain [1, 2, 3, 4]. However, transferring these methods to the medical domain is challenging due to the absence of comparable quality and quantity of the grounding data. Regardless, significant contextual and non-imaging information exists in medical images that remains underutilized. Few-shot learning (FSL) techniques partially address this limitation but struggle to general ize to unseen medical findings and require extensive retraining when new findings are introduced [5, 6]. To overcome these challenges, we extend our prior EM-DETR framework [7] and introduce a scalable FS detection approach designed for efficient abnormality detection in Chest X-Ray (CXR) images under minimal supervision. The proposed architecture incorporates exemplar-based feature generation and domain-aware contrastive optimization, enabling effective adaptation to novel disease findings without exhaustive retraining. Our method achieves near state-of-the-art (SOTA) detection performance using less than 10% of the annotated data, demonstrating its potential for practical, annotation-efficient clinical deployment across both proprietary and public CXR datasets.
tldr: This paper extends the EM-DETR framework to enable few-shot abnormality detection in chest X-rays, achieving near state-of-the-art performance with less than 10% annotated data through exemplar-based feature generation and domain-aware contrastive optimization.
tldr_zh: 该论文扩展了EM-DETR框架，通过基于示例的特征生成和领域感知对比优化，在胸部X光异常检测中以不到10%的标注数据实现了接近最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：减少标注需求仍然是开发鲁棒性医学目标检测器面临的关键挑战。为此，视觉-语言（VL）目标检测方法利用文本信息进行定位，从而在自然图像领域实现强大的零样本和少样本目标检测器[1, 2, 3, 4]。然而，由于缺乏同等质量和数量的定位数据，将这些方法迁移到医学领域具有挑战性。尽管如此，医学图像中仍存在大量未被充分利用的上下文和非成像信息。少样本学习（FSL）技术部分解决了这一局限，但难以泛化到未见的医学发现，且在引入新发现时需要大量重新训练[5, 6]。为克服这些挑战，我们扩展了先前的EM-DETR框架[7]，并提出了一种可扩展的少样本检测方法，旨在以极少的监督实现胸部X射线（CXR）图像中高效异常检测。所提出的架构结合了基于示例的特征生成和领域感知对比优化，能够在无需大量重新训练的情况下有效适应新的疾病发现。我们的方法使用不到10%的标注数据即可达到接近最优（SOTA）的检测性能，展示了其在专有和公开CXR数据集上实现高效标注的临床部署潜力。

title: Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) has recently benefited from large language models, which substantially improve report fluency. However, clinically faithful generation remains challenging because current supervision is still imposed mostly at the report level. This creates a granularity mismatch: radiology reports are composed of disease-grounded findings, while existing methods are trained mainly with whole-report objectives. To address this problem, we propose Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment, which reformulates image-report supervision as a hierarchical clinical alignment problem. Our method structures this alignment as a disease-conditioned process, where supervision is decomposed into two levels: Disease-Centric Alignment for fine-grained disease-specific correspondence, and Global Clinical Semantic Alignment for report-level semantic coherence. A clinical knowledge graph is used as a training-time-only structural prior that defines disease-specific supervision units and their clinical relationships, introducing no additional overhead at inference. Because standard contrastive alignment could produce false negatives when studies share overlapping pathologies, we combine instance-conditioned discriminative matching with disease-conditioned soft regularization, enabling fine-grained yet clinically consistent cross-modal representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, IU-Xray, and COV-CTR show that our method consistently improves performance on both conventional and clinical metrics. Notably, our 3B model surpasses several prior systems with larger 7B/13B backbones, suggesting that improving supervision structure, rather than increasing model size, can be more effective for RRG.
tldr: The paper proposes Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment to improve radiology report generation by decomposing image-report supervision into disease-centric and global semantic levels using a clinical knowledge graph, outperforming larger models without increasing model size.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出图监督的分层临床对齐方法，通过使用临床知识图谱将图像-报告监督分解为疾病中心对齐和全局语义对齐，从而改善放射学报告生成，在不增加模型大小的情况下超越大型模型。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
放射学报告生成（RRG）近期受益于大语言模型，显著提升了报告的流畅性。然而，临床保真生成仍面临挑战，因为当前的监督主要仍施加于报告层级。这导致了粒度不匹配：放射学报告由基于疾病的发现组成，而现有方法主要基于整体报告目标进行训练。为解决这一问题，我们提出图监督分层临床对齐（Graph-Supervised Hierarchical Clinical Alignment），将图像-报告监督重新定义为分层临床对齐问题。我们的方法将该对齐结构化为一个疾病条件化过程，其中监督被分解为两个层级：以疾病为中心的对齐（Disease-Centric Alignment）实现细粒度的疾病特异性对应，以及全局临床语义对齐（Global Clinical Semantic Alignment）实现报告层级的语义连贯性。临床知识图谱作为仅在训练时使用的结构先验，定义了疾病特异性监督单元及其临床关系，推理时无额外开销。由于标准对比对齐在研究中存在重叠病理时可能产生假阴性，我们将实例条件判别匹配与疾病条件软正则化相结合，从而实现细粒度且临床一致的跨模态表示。在MIMIC-CXR、IU-Xray和COV-CTR上的实验表明，我们的方法在常规指标和临床指标上均持续提升性能。值得注意的是，我们的3B模型超越了多个先前使用更大7B/13B主干网络的系统，这表明改进监督结构而非增大模型规模对RRG更为有效。

title: Multi-Stage Prompt-Guided Feature Modulation for Generalizable Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, surgical guidance, and disease monitoring. However, developing automated segmentation models that generalize across diverse tumor characteristics, imaging protocols, acquisition sites, and patient populations remains challenging. Variations in tumor morphology and imaging distributions can substantially degrade performance outside the training domain. Consequently, improving the robustness and generalization of deep learning-based segmentation models has become a key objective in medical image analysis. To improve segmentation robustness, we propose Multi-Stage Dynamic Prompt nnU-Net, a prompt-conditioned extension of nnU-Net. Three independent dynamic prompt modules are inserted into the deepest encoder stages. Each module contains a learnable bank of ten 256-dimensional prompt vectors and uses globally pooled encoder features to generate image-specific prompt representations. These representations are projected into feature-wise scaling $(γ)$ and shifting $(β)$ parameters that modulate encoder feature maps through Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM), enabling adaptive feature conditioning at multiple semantic levels. Evaluation on the BraTS GOAT validation dataset demonstrated that the proposed Multi-Stage Dynamic Prompt nnU-Net outperformed the baseline nnU Net across the majority of evaluated metrics and tumor subregions. The proposed model achieved average lesion-wise Dice scores of 76.16% (ET), 80.04% (TC), and 86.42% (WT), compared with 74.38%, 78.14% and 84.01% for the baseline model. The results demonstrate that multi-stage dynamic prompt conditioning improves segmentation accuracy and boundary delineation for brain tumor segmentation.
tldr: Proposes a multi-stage dynamic prompt mechanism integrated into nnU-Net for brain tumor segmentation, using FiLM-based feature modulation to improve generalization across domains; achieves consistent improvements on BraTS GOAT validation.
tldr_zh: 提出一种多阶段动态提示机制集成到 nnU-Net 中用于脑肿瘤分割，利用 FiLM 特征调制提升跨域泛化能力；在 BraTS GOAT 验证集上取得一致改进。
summary_zh: 从磁共振成像（MRI）中准确分割脑肿瘤对于诊断、治疗规划、手术引导和疾病监测至关重要。然而，开发能够泛化于不同肿瘤特征、成像协议、采集部位和患者群体的自动化分割模型仍面临挑战。肿瘤形态和成像分布的变异可能导致模型在训练领域外的性能显著下降。因此，提高基于深度学习的分割模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力已成为医学图像分析的关键目标。为增强分割鲁棒性，我们提出了多阶段动态提示nnU-Net，这是nnU-Net的一种提示条件化扩展。三个独立的动态提示模块被插入最深层的编码器阶段。每个模块包含一个可学习的由十个256维提示向量组成的向量库，并利用全局池化的编码器特征生成图像特定的提示表示。这些表示被投影为特征级缩放(γ)和偏移(β)参数，通过特征级线性调制（FiLM）调节编码器特征图，从而在多个语义层级实现自适应特征条件化。在BraTS GOAT验证数据集上的评估表明，所提出的多阶段动态提示nnU-Net在大多数评估指标和肿瘤子区域上优于基线nnU-Net。该模型在病变水平上的平均Dice分数分别为76.16%（ET）、80.04%（TC）和86.42%（WT），而基线模型分别为74.38%、78.14%和84.01%。结果表明，多阶段动态提示条件化提高了脑肿瘤分割的准确性和边界描绘能力。
